limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

DEFENSE_ORDERS.rationale: Verified orders/contracts and material procurement signals: Iran war cost to Pentagon, Northrop contract, BEL order win, additive-manufacturing assessment, Qatar-Turkiye pact, €1bn defense fund, autonomous-weapons talks, China defense sanctions/Cuba visit.

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Authoritative macro data: euro-area industrial production, UK GDP, Kazakhstan GDP, India unemployment, Norway/Finland unemployment, China ten-month economy, Sri Lanka PMI.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Global oil glut/supply-surplus price move is heavily corroborated; plus verified deals (Eni-Libya, Saudi-Syria, Morocco, Samsung LNG), refinery shutdown, Japan GDP/oil impact, and rate assumptions.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: Authoritative financial-stability warnings on AI boom (Fed/ECB), AI-selloff FX moves, HSBC Algeria exit, hotel loan default, student-loan collections, 401k hardship withdrawal rise, Yes Bank bond ruling, ECB supervision.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Verified policy/regulatory changes: Medicaid work-requirement extension, FDA rejection of Summit drug, stroke-drug approval, MiniMed pump approval, biosimilar approval, weight-loss drug coverage cuts; drug-pricing study.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Verified material state changes: large Ukraine drone strike, EU Ukraine funding, EU Russia sanctions, Iraq militia deadline, Yemen/Houthi conflict, Ecuador drone-attack lawsuit, oil price move on supply/Middle East tension; killer-robot treaty talks corroborated across sources.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Verified central-bank actions/signals: BoJ hiking, UK inflation path, Romania forecast hike, RBA upside risks, soft Canadian CPI reaction, India WPI, US PPI, PBoC withdrawal. Excluded partisan tariff-inflation op-eds.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Verified political shocks: US shutdown deal, Spain snap-election far-right question, Canada earthquake fund, Pacific hurricane risk, Indonesia M6.6 quake, Florida emergency extension, Ghana mining emergency call, Turkey election lead.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Gold's 3% drop to lowest since Oct 2025 on rate fears is corroborated; plus RBI gold reserve surge, Dalio gold-diversifier view, Pakistan gold selloff, silver bottoming debate, Endeavour output flag, plus mining drill/feasibility results.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Verified state changes: tightened AI chip export controls (corroborated), Korea ICT export surge, California suit vs OpenAI, grid interconnection reform, data-center emissions study, Greece buildout, legal challenges to data-center restrictions, Q3 fund flows.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Verified policy actions: EU steel anti-dumping tariffs on multiple countries, US AI chip export licenses, lamb tariff path, Mexico tariff threat, Indonesia-Canada CEPA, China zero-tariff, India-Egypt talks, tariff-driven relocation.
